Reserves रिज़र्व

Profits kept in the business over time instead of being paid out as dividends.

हिंदी में: रिज़र्व

समय के साथ कारोबार में रखे गए मुनाफ़े, जो डिविडेंड के रूप में नहीं बाँटे गए।

How it is used in the lessons

Equity: what is left for shareholders after liabilities: share capital plus reserves and surplus.

From How to Read a Balance Sheet

Directors' report: dividend, transfers to reserves, subsidiaries, and related-party contracts.

From How to Read an Annual Report

A bonus issue gives existing shareholders free additional shares from company reserves, in a fixed ratio.
